performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; organic holds but 5 SOW gates are overdue.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google both $0. No ROAS or purchase data possible. Revenue engine is fully off.
Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (due 2026-08-14) shows no completed event — 18 days overdue. Creative pipeline stall blocks renewal ad ramp.
4 milestones due 2026-08-31 unresolved: Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM, SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — all 0 days past due today.
GBP actions dropped -34.83% last 7d; last 3 series days (Aug 29–31) show 0 vs prior 3-day avg of ~33 — likely a data lag, not a true collapse.
GA4 sessions averaging ~270/day over last 7 days with 0 purchases recorded — organic traffic is live but no conversion signal exists without paid or Shopify events.

suggestions.text: Resolve all 4 Aug-31 SOW blockers this week before any paid budget is reactivated.
suggestions.monday_update: Four milestones — Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — were all due 2026-08-31 and remain unresolved. No paid campaigns should reactivate until the Funnel Test is closed and UTMs are live, as $0 spend with unresolved attribution means any budget reactivated now will generate untrackable revenue. Success check: all 4 items marked complete in Monday by 2026-09-05. Nacer to confirm with Sohib.

suggestions.text: Escalate Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (18 days overdue); secure real footage before any Meta creative refresh launches.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and has no completed event recorded — it is 18 days overdue as of today. The SOW creative rules require real footage (no AI video, no stock substitutes for this deliverable), and the renewal ad ramp cannot begin without it given the known creative fatigue from the test phase. Action: Nacer to get a confirmed reschedule date from Haney/Ameer by 2026-09-03. Success check: shoot date confirmed and on the Video board calendar.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP Aug 29–31 zero-action days; confirm data lag before treating as a real -34.83% engagement drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions read 0 for the last 3 days of the series (Aug 29–31), driving the reported -34.83% 7-day decline, but the prior 3-day average was ~33 actions/day with no profile change logged. This pattern is consistent with a reporting lag rather than an actual drop. Re-check on 2026-09-04: if the Aug 29–31 values populate above 20/day, no action needed. If confirmed zero, investigate whether a GBP suspension or profile edit triggered the drop.
